response.sql: SELECT sc.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Fraction is COUNT per (zoneref, insurstat) group divided by total matched conservation records (after the inner join), computed as a real number without rounding.
A NULL insurstat is kept as its own group (GROUP BY treats NULLs as one group). Empty-string statuses, if any, are treated as distinct values, not as missing.
Since the fraction is highest-first, NULL ordering is irrelevant (fraction is never NULL), so 'missing last' only concerns the status, which is not a sort key.
